routes.notes: Route Massive through hot zone and lava. Keep stamina for jumping, bring spare items; Falling into lava can cause you to lose all your items.
kit: Light source; mark the withdrawal path

routes.name: Tek Cave

entrances.label: Area Tek Cave · data center, unlatched entrance

routes.notes: Tek Cave area follows the cave layer Ascended Wikily. This is the center of the area, not the verified door GPS. The actual door is on top of the Volcano; Need to survey the terminal and convert the coordinate system before sending the team in. Route without artifacts, use trophy guardian to open the door then go to Overseer.
kit: Trophy at the correct level of the three guardians
Alpha drops by level, read section Overseer
Survey the lava, curves and gates at the top of Volcano
